name: grid_v1
description: Electricity grid and solar power: entity aliases (solar PV / photovoltaic), a revised capacity figure, conflicting claims about curtailment in different years, and a stated causal mechanism.
padding: Appendix tables list substation identifiers, metering intervals and the data cleaning steps applied before analysis.

documents.title: grid-2020.txt
paragraphs: Grid Report 2020. Solar PV capacity reached 4 gigawatts on the regional grid in 2020.
Curtailment of solar output stayed below 2 percent of generation in 2020 because demand absorbed midday supply.
Battery storage remains limited on the regional grid in 2020.

documents.title: grid-2024.txt
paragraphs: Grid Report 2024. Solar PV capacity reached 9 gigawatts on the regional grid in 2024.
Curtailment of solar output rose to 7 percent of generation in 2024 during spring afternoons.
Transmission congestion causes curtailment when midday solar output exceeds export capacity in 2024.

documents.title: journal-2023.txt
paragraphs: Energy Systems Journal 2023. Photovoltaic growth correlates with midday price drops across the regional grid.
Battery storage reduces curtailment by shifting midday photovoltaic output into the evening peak.

Curtailment of solar output rose to 7 percent of generation in 2024 during spring afternoons.

Battery storage reduces curtailment by shifting midday photovoltaic output into the evening peak.
